description: This file contains tests for various components, including protocol codable helpers, shell execution, node info serialization, port guardian listeners, file scheme handling, UI elements, and network utilities within a macOS application.

classes.name: LowCoverageHelperTests
classes.description: Test suite struct for various helper and component tests in the application.

methods.name: any codable helper accessors
methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of OpenClawProtocol.AnyCodable with various payloads.

methods.description: Tests stripping foreground color attribute from NSMutableAttributedString.

methods.description: Verifies reduction of view width in ViewMetricsTesting.

methods.description: Tests encoding and decoding of NodeInfo struct.
